dct_description_sm: # Nepal Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Nov 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Nepal Earthquake (Nov 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Nepal, Earthquake, 6 Nov 2023, v0.7** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Nepal, Earthquake, 6 Nov 2023, v0.7** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023)
